13.description: This item proposes rezoning land near Cowessess Road and Brighton Boulevard in the Brighton neighbourhood to allow for one to four-unit residential dwellings and related community uses.

chips.text: Two residents called seeking clarification on zoning impact on park space and wetlands.
Proposed zoning applies to municipal reserve and wetland complex lands.

14.description: Saskatoon will sell 1.2 acres of Nutana Kiwanis Park North to Elmwood Residences for $1.77 million, supporting a new community hub with 42 affordable housing units and accessible services for people with disabilities, seniors, and Indigenous peoples.

chips.text: Mayor Block praised Elmwood's 'heart and soul' approach to building community and inclusive spaces.
